text: Burlington Vermont Residential and Commercial Architect - studioblue Architecture Skip to main content Menu Home Residential Commercial About Contact Main content We can all appreciate good design. A good design is meaningful, contemplative and inspiring. Whether it is your home, office, store or restaurant, your space represents you. Yet many times, we conform to the spaces we live and work in even though we are all individuals with different needs. Having a design tailored to fit allows you to get the most from your investment and can enhance your life. Residential Commercial About studioblue Architecture provides full Architectural services from Design Concepts through Construction Detailing and Management. We help define our clients needs, organize their options and develop a design concept that creates a foundation for making decisions. We educate our clients on the design and building process, including permits, and we oversee the project until construction is complete. We pride ourselves in the product we deliver and the affordability of our services. Whether making improvements upon an existing building or starting new, cost is always a concern. It is important to us to make sure our clients goals are met within their budget. info@ studiobluearchitecture.com • 802.540.0484 p.o. box 4191 • burlington, VT 05406 This site is carbon-offset with Ecopixel

title: Woman-owned design and architecture firm  -  studioblue Architecture
text: Woman-owned design and architecture firm - studioblue Architecture Skip to main content Menu Home Residential Commercial About (current) Contact Main content Our Studio studioblue Architecture was established in 2008 in Burlington, VT by Donna Church, AIA. This woman-owned business focuses on designing residential and small scale commercial projects. With projects of all sizes, located across the country, she has developed the skills of listening to her clients, developing appropriate designs and working with contractors to make projects happen. Her creative talents are continuously explored through the mediums of Art & Architecture. Our goal at studioblue Architecture is to educate our clients about their options in order to help minimize the impacts of construction on the environment. This begins in the design process by carefully choosing where the building is placed in the landscape and from there the design evolves based on solar orientation and our clients program. Many environmentally sustainable decisions are integrated into the selection of the structural, mechanical and electrical systems. We also educate our clients about the use of renewable resources and sustainable materials when choosing the finishes for their projects. ____ info@ studiobluearchitecture.com • 802.540.0484 p.o. box 4191 • burlington, VT 05406 This site is carbon-offset with Ecopixel
